references.text: Moses laid his hands on Joshua and gave him the commission, just as the Lord had commanded. This shows the direct chain of command from the Lord through Moses to Joshua.
Moses commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous and to lead the people into the promised land. This is the foundation for the commands that Joshua followed.
Moses was the servant of the Lord who spoke with God face to face. Joshua 11:15 refers to Moses as 'the servant of the Lord' and confirms his authority.

The Lord commanded Joshua to keep the entire law that Moses had given him, and not to turn from it. This corresponds to the fact that Joshua did not remove anything from what the Lord had commanded Moses.
Moses conveyed the Lord's command to strike down the peoples in Canaan with the ban and completely destroy them. Joshua carried this out exactly as commanded.
The command was not to let anything that breathes live in the Canaanite cities. Joshua faithfully followed this command in his conquests.
Joshua built an altar and read aloud the entire law, just as Moses had commanded. This confirms Joshua's faithful obedience to Moses' commands.
